messages:
zoe (mktg): quick flag for the weekly KPI readout tomorrow 1 1 our launch-posts block shows 456 leads on the live dashboard but downstream systems (HubSpot/SFDC) are substantially lower. suspecting two oddities: influencer reposts that strip UTMs and a short ingestion backlog. can ppl sanity-check? :mag:
hannah (analytics): good call. i noticed a set of referrals from linkedin.com with no utm params in the raw events. looks like the influencer share might be rewriting the link (or LinkedIn strip) 
revops-jake: also saw ~40 events arrive delayed in the ingestion pipeline yesterday due to a transient webhook retry loop. those late events were tagged after the HS sync window and won't show as HS campaign-tagged for that day
oli (growth): interesting. i can add a quick rule to treat linkedin referrers without utm as "launch-inferred" for reporting, but we should not change what we send to HS. instead, add a reconciliation row on the KPI one-pager that shows "inferred-launch (UTM-stripped)"
paige (sales): from the sales side we see ~310 records in SFDC in that window. a few of the high-ARR folks were manually tagged to enterprise and lost the original campaign tag during nurture handoff
zoe (mktg): propose actions before TOM's readout: 1) hannah run dedup + referer analysis for the launch window 2) revops-jake verify ingestion lag and list any late-arrival batches 3) oli add an "inferred-launch" reconciliation row to the dashboard and note why 4) paige flag any >$50k leads that lost tags
hannah (analytics): running quick dedupe now. SQL im using:
```sql
select
  case
    when utm_campaign is null and referrer ilike '%linkedin%' then 'inferred-launch-linkedin'
    else coalesce(utm_campaign, 'no-utm') end as campaign_label,
  count(distinct email) as unique_leads
from events.page_views
where received_at between '2026-03-09' and '2026-03-15'
  and page_path ilike '%/launch-posts%'
group by 1
order by unique_leads desc;
```
expect results in ~3-5 mins
revops-jake: ingestion check: saw a retry window 2026-03-12T21:10Z to 21:40Z that queued ~48 events. they were backfilled at 22:15Z. HS daily sync cut at 22:00Z so ~48 leads missed being campaign-tagged that day. i'll produce a short logfile slice and a list of affected event IDs
oli (growth): i'll implement the "inferred-launch-linkedin" row on the dashboard as a non-authoritative reconciliation number (visual hint: lighter color + tooltip explaining inference). won't touch HS payloads
paige (sales): i'll scan SFDC for manual-flagged enterprise routing and share if >5 leads had their campaign overwritten. if so, we'll show that as an explanatory footnote
ingest-bot: metric-quick: dashboard_raw=456, pipeline_sfdc=310, hubspot_tagged=287, inferred_linkedin_no_utm=42, delayed_ingest=48
hannah (analytics): SQL finished: unique_leads by label = inferred-launch-linkedin: 38, launch-q2: 369, no-utm-other: 21 (total distinct emails across launch page = 428). dedup reduced raw dashboard number because dashboard counts event rows by default
zoe (mktg): perfect. official numbers for the one-pager we'll present: 1) dashboard raw (event-rows) = 456 2) deduped distinct contacts = 428 3) hubspot campaign-tagged = 287 4) inferred-launch-linkedin = 38 5) ingestion-lag impact = 48 (explanatory)
revops-jake: i'll export the backfill IDs + timestamps and send a separate secure CSV to analytics & sales for manual matching
oli (growth): adding conv->mql and MQL quality sparkline to the dashboard too (requested by CRO). will push the reconciliation row and a tiny footnote: "inferred labels are heuristic and used only for internal reconciliations"
paige (sales): thanks. please surface top 10 emails for revops vetting so we can check owner assignment quickly
zoe (mktg): meeting TOM 9:15 to lock the one-pager. thank you everyone 1 :rocket:
